svg.title: Consensus contacts of 4 ligands
svg.desc: Consensus view of 4 ligands. Aligned on a common substructure: the largest common substructure has 24 of 28 heavy atoms of the smallest ligand (86 %).

g.text: Aligned on a common substructure: the largest common substructure has 24 of 28 heavy atoms of the smallest ligand (86 %). That
substructure sits on identical coordinates in every drawing. Drawn: dexamethasone, the member closest to that substructure; each residue
stands by the atoms that are nearest to it.
